properties.description:
Persist the agreed design direction and a bounded implementation plan before app storage exists.

Scope

• This plan pack only; no runtime changes.

Success criteria

1. Tasks, goals, criteria, dependencies and review checkpoints are explicit.

2. The pack has one canonical representation, mechanically validated references and a specified handoff procedure; the actual import/restart procedure is tested at T03.

Evidence

• plan.json

• PLAN.md

• VALIDATION.json

Planning artifact only. No implementation task is complete.
